label: v0.2.0 — War Room + Bid History tabs wired live
description: Two previously-placeholder tabs now load real data from new worker endpoints. War Room renders per-franchise cap status + cut-then-rebid block lists. Bid History renders chronological auction event feed with filter controls.

War Room tab: /api/auction/cut-rebid-blocks — §A2 block lists per franchise
Bid History tab: /api/auction/bid-history — chronological feed, filter by player/franchise/event-type
Lazy-load on tab activation (no fetch until user clicks)
Discord auction narrator (worker-side cron — narrates new bids/wins to Discord)
deferred: Nominate / bid worker endpoints (gated on war-room-vs-full-tool scope decision)
